svg.aria-label: A Raspberry Pi 4 Model B in isometric view: the green board with the BCM2711 system-on-chip under its heat spreader, LPDDR4 memory, the wireless module under a shield can, the 40-pin GPIO header, two USB 2.0 and two USB 3.0 ports, a Gigabit Ethernet jack, USB-C power, two micro-HDMI ports, the audio jack and the camera and display connectors. Hovering takes it apart into its layers.
